images.alt: A coral crab arranges HTML, CSS and JavaScript cards beside a small press that turns a Rust block into a web page.
images.caption: A generated page is an ordinary set of local assets. Rust produces them; a browser supplies layout and interaction.

images.alt: Rust passes through the bundled compiler and WASI program to generated assets; direct web files and generated assets converge on an immutable offline WebKit preview.
images.caption: The preview receives a bounded asset snapshot, and its external network is blocked. The drawing makes no performance claim.

images.alt: Ivory task blocks on a navy engineering board form a jade branching dependency graph beside a separate coral triangular cycle.
images.caption: A useful plan describes dependency readiness and distinguishes an actual cycle from the work waiting behind it.

images.alt: A dependency readiness trace shows config enabling core and core enabling cli and web; a separate cycle a-b blocks c without placing c in the cycle.
images.caption: Arrows in the readiness example mean enables. The cycle witness uses depends-on edges and names only the nodes on the closed walk.

images.alt: An old coral identification tag lies apart from a brass specimen rack where an ivory tray now contains a new jade specimen.
images.caption: A reused position is not the same object. A handle needs enough identity to tell those cases apart.

images.alt: A three-stage slot lifecycle shows generation 4 holding A, removal advancing to 5, and reuse by B; an old generation-4 handle is rejected.
images.caption: Lookup compares owner, slot and generation. An empty slot at the maximum generation is retired instead of wrapping.

images.alt: Three jade computation capsules on separate brass tracks pause at gates in a dark observatory workshop.
images.caption: Cooperation requires places where work returns control. A future that never yields cannot give its neighbors a turn.

images.alt: A poll decision diagram separates Ready, Pending with a wake request, and Pending without a wake request, with a caller-controlled budget.
images.caption: The driver returns control both when work stalls and when its allotted turn ends. A wake request permits scheduling; it does not authorize unlimited work.

images.alt: A coral crab places a milestone token in a local notebook, separate from an optional achievement display.
images.caption: The learning record belongs to the local application. An optional social display is a projection of that record.

images.alt: An attempt passes validation and deduplication into a local ledger; duplicate requests make no change and optional Game Center receives a separate projection.
images.caption: Identical retries are harmless; conflicting reuse of an identifier is an error. The example models an in-memory transition, not durable database transactions.
